chunks.title: Context, delta & dependency pin
chunks.summary: Inspect the four packages, write the keep/refactor/missing delta report, and pin dependency versions.
chunks.dod: Written delta + pinned versions; decision review only for latest-together conflicts.

chunks.title: Contracts & core ports
chunks.summary: Shared zod contracts and core ports, with type-only coupling linted and runtime purity tested.
chunks.dod: Boundary lint and runtime-purity tests pass; contract and port suites cover the surface.

chunks.title: API security foundation, replica-set profile & env sync
chunks.summary: Request ids, redacted logs, safe errors, client-IP rate limiting, strict CORS, health probes, the CSRF foundation and the Mongo transaction manager.
chunks.dod: API startup, health probes, the CSRF matrix and replica-set commit and rollback tests pass.

chunks.title: Cookie-session auth, PIN, OTP & OAuth
chunks.summary: Cookie sessions, verified signup, password and OTP sign-in, Google and Facebook, account self-service, admin PIN, invites, resume, Account Security, the permission registry, roles and customer CRM.
chunks.dod: Sign-in, session, authority and CRM flows are tested, including real provider accounts and browser PIN sign-in.

chunks.title: Mongo persistence & transaction adoption
chunks.summary: Mongoose models, repositories and transactions for accounts, catalogue, media, inventory, governance and content.
chunks.dod: Adapter integration tests cover uniqueness, TTL, visibility, rollback and response-safe mapping.

chunks.title: Catalog, SEO, search & merchandising
chunks.summary: Catalogue reads and writes, SEO, Meilisearch search and merchandising. The storefront and admin product form use the API. Search outbox work is open.
chunks.dod: Public and admin catalogue, indexed live products, and search and facet tests.

chunks.title: Cart, checkout, orders & payment/shipping ports
chunks.summary: Server cart and guest adoption, pricing engine, payment and shipping ports, and order, payment, shipment, return and refund shapes. Customer-facing order numbers wait on the numbering decision.
chunks.dod: Cart adoption, quote, non-production payment/shipping implementations and ownership tests; order placement remains internal-id-only or gated.

chunks.title: Inventory, purchase invoices, reporting & insights
chunks.summary: Inventory ledger and FIFO layers, analytics aggregates, weekly insights and purchase-invoice drafts. Posting purchase invoices waits on the numbering decision.
chunks.dod: Ledger + aggregates; purchase-invoice posting waits on the numbering decision.

chunks.title: Privacy, content, FAQ, reviews & media
chunks.summary: Consent, FAQ, questions, reviews, and the image pipeline: presigned upload, worker, size roles, banners, YouTube and moderation. Email thumbnails, PWA caching and live garbage collection are open.
chunks.dod: Consent gating, moderation model, media presign and derivatives.

chunks.title: Docs, seeds, verification & infra close-out
chunks.summary: OpenAPI, runbooks, seeds, verification and deployment scripts. Production decisions are recorded in the decision log. The deployment pipeline is not built, and secret delivery is an open decision.
chunks.dod: Docs aligned, seeds complete, checks green and deployment scripts documented.
